name: CINNABARIS
key_symptoms: Congestion to head; face purple red.
Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers; coldness of joints.
guiding_symptoms: Congestion to head; face purple red.
Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers; coldness of joints.

worse: lying on right side (feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side)

head_symptoms: Congestion to head; face purple red.
urinary_symptoms: Prepuce swollen; warts on it which bleed easily; testicles enlarged; buboes; angry-looking chancres. Syphilides, squamous and vesicular.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers; coldness of joints.
skin_symptoms: Very fiery-red looking ulcers. Nodes on shin-bones. Buboes. Condyloma, easily bleeding.

source.title: CINNABARIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
